# Fixed PWM beeper source fixtures

Exact files from Klipper commit `fe4eb8650bd7de4c2100a14eaf09b0965c430e29`,
also checked at `ce7002bedf37e938bb483572949f3703ac6476cb` (identical hashes).
Source: https://github.com/Klipper3d/klipper/tree/fe4eb8650bd7de4c2100a14eaf09b0965c430e29/config

Upstream copyright/license apply (Klipper GPLv3). Keep bytes unchanged: reviewed
profile names, SHA-256, section options and physical pins are recorded in
`data/fixed_pwm_beepers.json`. This qualification concerns these beeper circuits
only, not entire printers or physical electrical performance. These three source
files contain no beeper consumer. Sources with M300/dynamic-cycle consumers are
not qualified by a matching section name.
